name: Belshazzar
charge: Drinking from the temple vessels and praising the gods of gold and silver
summary: At a feast for a thousand lords, Belshazzar called for the gold and silver vessels Nebuchadnezzar had taken from the house of God in Jerusalem, drank wine from them with his wives and concubines, and praised the gods of gold, silver, brass, iron, wood, and stone. Fingers of a man's hand wrote on the plaster.
offense: Daniel's indictment: thou hast lifted up thyself against the Lord of heaven, and the God in whose hand thy breath is, and whose are all thy ways, hast thou not glorified. He knew what had happened to his father and humbled not his heart.
judgment: Mene, mene, tekel, upharsin: numbered, weighed and found wanting, divided. In that night was Belshazzar the king of the Chaldeans slain, and Darius the Median took the kingdom.
